text:
Por the espaciosa brow pálida and pensativa,

desciende the melena in dos rizos iguales.

Negros eyes miopes, gruesa nose lasciva,

the faz oval and fina, the lips sensuales.


over the flexible body, perturban the negrura

of the enlutado traje that his pain retrata,

the d’annunziano cuello with his nívea blancura

and with manchas sangrientas the flotante corbata.


Apura a cigarrillo Kedive, reclinado

in a diván oscuro, and among the humo azulado

of the tabaco, his eyes contemplan with love


the azul of the venas over the hands finas,

dignas of rasgar velos of princesas latinas

and ceñir the anillo of the Santo Pescador.
